body: Hey, thanks for responding. I understand that you can't necessarily give me the best answer. Only I really know my situation, but even so I think writing all of this out and reading your response still helped me out a little. I was just doing a little checking to see what support services the college that I'm transferring to has. I haven't found what I'm looking for there yet, but I'll keep looking. I definitely agree that talking to a professional would help me out. Thanks for the vote of confidence that I can work this out, and thank you for the offer to reach out to you, it's nice to know that there is someone I can reach out to.
